title: Wet Floral Foam Bricks
summary: Standard wet floral foam bricks for fresh arrangements. Holds water and stems securely. Sold in packs of 6, 12 or 24.
descriptionHtml:
Reliable wet floral foam for building fresh-flower arrangements, centrepieces and sympathy tributes. Each brick soaks quickly, holds water well and grips stems at any angle so designs stay put through transport and display.

A workhorse for busy studios and a practical choice for anyone arranging at home. Buy the larger packs for event work and wedding builds.

  • Type: Wet foam (fresh flowers only)
  • Brick size: Approx. 23 x 11 x 8cm each
  • Pack options: 6, 12 or 24 bricks
  • Use: Soak in water until saturated, then insert stems
seoTitle: Wet Floral Foam Bricks | The New Greenhouse
seoDescription: Wet floral foam bricks in packs of 6, 12 or 24. Floral supplies in Jamaica for florists and home arrangers. Pickup or delivery in Kingston.
careInstructions: Soak bricks in water until fully saturated before inserting stems; do not press foam down into water as this creates dry pockets.
deliveryNote: Available for store pickup in Kingston. Same-day delivery may be available across Kingston & St. Andrew for orders placed before 2PM.
wholesaleNote: Bulk pack pricing for florists and event planners; contact us for case quantities on standing orders.

descriptionHtml:

Choose Small for bud and bar arrangements, Medium for hand-tied bouquets, and Large for statement pieces and event installs.

  • Small: Approx. 15cm high, 10cm diameter
  • Medium: Approx. 20cm high, 12cm diameter
  • Large: Approx. 30cm high, 15cm diameter
